name: Downs sparkling
note: Made the slow, careful way; tastes of green apples and toast.

name: Loire white
note: Crisp as a fresh apple, with a squeeze of lemon. Perfect with fish.

name: Alsace Riesling
note: Flowery and bright, with just enough sweetness to tame a spicy sauce.

name: White Burgundy
note: Rich, nutty and buttery; lobster's best friend.

name: Provence rosé
note: Pale pink and sunny, like a summer holiday in a glass.

name: Rioja reserva
note: Warm vanilla and red berries from years asleep in oak barrels.

name: Red Burgundy
note: Light, silky and famously fussy to grow; wine experts sigh over it.

name: Sauternes
note: Golden and honey-sweet; made from grapes that are allowed to go wrinkly.
